customer_question: Since Sunday our daily 07:00 report workflow runs at 08:00 our time. Nothing changed on our side. Is the scheduler broken? We're in Sydney.
resolution: Not a scheduler fault. New schedules default to UTC and this one had never been given a named time zone; UTC does not move with daylight saving. When Sydney clocks moved forward on 6 October, the same UTC time became 08:00 local time. Set the schedule's time zone to Australia/Sydney in the workflow's schedule trigger; the next run started at 07:00 local time. Advised checking the other schedules in the workspace for the same setting.
